skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature and role of managerial accounting
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the essence and role of managerial accounting in businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Identifying different types of costs for decision-making
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Differentiate various types of costs in business operations for decision-making purposes.
Analyze the relationship between costs, volume, and profit for decision-making.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing break-even points and target profits
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze break-even points and target profits.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing safety margins, product structures, cost structures, and operating leverage
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the impact of product structure, cost structure, and operating leverage on business decisions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Building cost standards and production budgeting systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Construct cost standards and production budgeting systems for businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing variances between actual and budgeted figures
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze differences between actual and budgeted figures, explain reasons for variances, and prepare variance reports.
Practice working independently and in teams.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Self-management and responsibility for learning outcomes
